design.notes: Aggregate expected wage-bill loss is held fixed at each division's declared s_j at every phi: the loss fraction is clip(phi, s_j, 1) and the selection probability is s_j / clip(phi, s_j, 1), whose product is s_j exactly. Nobody changes employment state anywhere on the sweep, so the only thing varying is the concentration of a fixed loss. phi <= min_j s_j reproduces the diffuse wage cut; phi = 1 reproduces the concentrated wage cut (bit-identical under bernoulli assignment).
